pages.title: Digital Circus Caine Jumping in Underwater Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Caine jumping in the underwater kingdom, raising his cane and open glove while four small fish swim around his bent legs. Branching coral, leafy sea plants, bubbles, and open shells fill the surrounding seabed, with a pearl inside one shell adding a small circular detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Digital Circus Caine Standing in Glitch Zone Coloring Page

pages.title: Digital Circus Caine Sitting in Toy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Caine sitting in a toy village, perched on a small house among miniature homes, round-canopied trees, and a curving model train track. A feather and star decorate his hat, and tiny window grids, roof slats, chimneys, and train wheels provide detailed sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Digital Circus Caine Running in Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Caine runs across a floating island in this printable coloring page, carrying a staff with a small tooth-shaped head while a winding path leads toward separate rocky platforms. Tall crystals, scattered stones, and spiky plants mark the island surface, with stars and clouds filling the open sky around the coloring sheet.
